Parser keys: status project listBranch workspace noAI agent home env branch port http httpsPort publicPort json deleteData main rebuild detach failure follow compose offset global profile run check updateCheck timeout

Defaults | framework help (names, aliases, types, choices and descriptions)
agent: "" | --agent text A user-defined piece of text. Coding agent: codex, claude, pi or opencode. Overrides saved selection. This setting is optional.
json: false | --json A true or false value. Print the result as JSON. This setting is optional. This setting is optional.
global: false | --global A true or false value. Install agent integration in your home directory. This setting is optional. This setting is optional.
home: "<hub home>" | --home text A user-defined piece of text. Hub data directory. Default: CONTREMAITRE_HOME or ~/.local/share/contremaitre. This setting is optional.
branch: "" | --branch text A user-defined piece of text. Override the detected branch or bookmark name. This setting is optional.
port: 8080 | --http-port integer An integer. Hub HTTP port when starting it. Default: 8080. This setting is optional.
http: false | --http A true or false value. Use legacy HTTP routing instead of local HTTPS. This setting is optional. This setting is optional.
httpsPort: 8443 | --https-port integer An integer. Local TLS listener. Default: 8443; forward port 443 to this port. This setting is optional.
publicPort: 0 | --public-port integer An integer. Legacy HTTP public port. Requires --http. Default: the HTTP port. This setting is optional.
main: false | --main A true or false value. Designate this environment as the initial clone source. This setting is optional. This setting is optional.
rebuild: false | --rebuild A true or false value. Build again instead of reusing an unchanged image. This setting is optional. This setting is optional.
detach: false | ( -d, --detach ) A true or false value. Return the operation immediately without following it. This setting is optional. This setting is optional.
timeout: 1800 | --timeout integer An integer. Wait deadline in seconds, 1..7200. Timeout leaves the operation running. This setting is optional.
env: "" | --env text A user-defined piece of text. Environment ID or name. Default: current workspace. This setting is optional.
profile: "smoke" | --profile text A user-defined piece of text. Verification profile. Default: smoke. This setting is optional.
offset: 0 | --offset integer An integer. Resume operation logs at this byte offset. Default: 0. This setting is optional.
run: "" | --run text A user-defined piece of text. Verification or deployment operation ID. This setting is optional.
check: "" | --check text A user-defined piece of text. Read diagnostics for this check. This setting is optional.
noAI: false | --no-ai A true or false value. Use conventional detection without a coding agent. This setting is optional. This setting is optional.
compose: "" | --compose text A user-defined piece of text. Select Compose input. With --no-ai, import the supported subset. This setting is optional.
status: [] | --status running | deploying | pending | stopping | deleting | failed | stopped ... One of the following: running, deploying, pending, stopping, deleting, failed, stopped Filter by status: running, deploying, pending, stopping, deleting, failed, stopped. Repeat to match any selected status. This option may be repeated zero or more times. This setting is optional.
project: "" | --project text A user-defined piece of text. Filter by exact project name. This setting is optional.
listBranch: "" | --branch text A user-defined piece of text. Filter by exact branch or bookmark name across projects. This setting is optional.
deleteData: false | --delete-data A true or false value. Also delete retained environment data. Default: false. This setting is optional. This setting is optional.
workspace: "" | --workspace text A user-defined piece of text. SaaS workspace ID. Overrides the saved selection. This setting is optional.
updateCheck: false | --check A true or false value. Check the latest release without downloading or restarting the hub. This setting is optional. This setting is optional.
failure: false | --failure A true or false value. Print logs from failed services in the latest deployment; empty after success. This setting is optional. This setting is optional.
follow: false | ( -f, --follow ) A true or false value. Follow deployment output until completion. Default: print and exit. This setting is optional. This setting is optional.
